path.description: The repository this file configures: the absolute path of its root (a bare repository: its git directory).

nickname.description: Label the ADE board shows instead of the repository name. Empty uses the name.

integration_branches.description: Branches tasks merge into, besides the main branch.

name.description: Environment name shown on the ADE board.

deployed_sha_script.description: Shell script that prints the commit deployed there. It runs in the repository root on board refresh. Never interpolated.

environments.description: Deploy targets the ADE board tracks.

prepare_script.description: Shell script that runs in each new task worktree. Never interpolated. Empty runs nothing.

prepare_timeout.description: Time limit of the prepare script, a duration such as 15m, above 0 and at most 2h.

base_path.description: Absolute folder the worktree dialog suggests for new worktrees. Empty suggests none.

scope.description: Which commits the graph shows: all refs, or only those reachable from HEAD.

include_untracked.description: The stash dialog starts with untracked files included.

base_candidates.description: Candidate base branches of a review, in order. Tried after the upstream and the detected default branch fail.

strategy.description: How a pull integrates remote commits. auto follows the repository's own Git config.

provider.description: auto detects the host from the origin remote, off makes no host call.

auto_stash.description: A checkout blocked by local changes retries with auto-stash instead of opening the checkout dialog.
